aggregation_policy: B20 regenerates this compatibility view from PACKET_STATUS and preserves legacy evidence. Workers save unique PROGRESS records and PACKET_DELTA compatibility copies; there is one authoritative state, not two independent ledgers.
two_axis_policy: deliverable_status records whether the packet contract has been checked and satisfied; mathematical_status records whether its target is open, conditional, proved, refuted or finite-only. A reviewed no-go can complete an appropriate diagnostic packet while the full-FEI target stays OPEN. A useful partial derivation is saved without pretending its packet is complete.
